tests.note: 975 modules transformed, built in 3s — compiles all SFCs/JS, catches import/syntax/template errors. No JS unit-test runner in repo (per Dalton: build + browser QA only, no new deps).

deviations: Phase 3.5 Postgres provisioning deferred to pre-Phase-6: frontend-only ticket, JS unit tests touch no DB; provisioning's only purpose is the agent-QA browser venue.
No per-node worktree fan-out in Phase 4: single cohesive FE concern, shared new composables imported by 3 components — implemented sequentially in the run worktree.
Test strategy = build + browser QA (no JS test runner exists; adding vitest declined to avoid a dependency change). Dalton-approved.

lanes: insightlpr:adversarial-reviewer (in-session substitute for rigor review.sh, which fails under the embedded harness — nested claude -p not logged in)
findings_fixed: MEDIUM/AC8: bottom stat bar collapse leaked into admin Org Map mode (showStatBar had no !adminMode guard) — gated chip+handle on !adminMode and force-expanded bar in admin; admin now pixel-identical (pt-3, no handle, never writes the shared localStorage key). Re-review RN2 = 100/100.

LOW (RN3, accordion follow-up): rewritten watch(isCompact) read a stale captured `stored` snapshot, discarding an explicit open/collapse on breakpoint rotation (grouped widgets + bottom sheet; reload-masked). Fixed by reading localStorage live in persistedOrDefault() and dropping the redundant hasExplicitChoice. RN3 = 90/100.

LOW (RN4, mobile controls relocation): hiding the controls widget on compact stops --scout-controls-h being published, so DayOverlay/TripOverlay (which read it for their top offset) mis-offset on compact. Fixed: branch their top offset on isCompact (small offset) like DashboardOverlay. RN4 = 90/100.
findings_residual: LOW/AC5: error toast (z-30) overlaps the Map Layers card only when an error is active AND the user has manually expanded layers on a compact screen — no clean side-by-side fit on a phone; toast stays on top/readable.
NIT: useViewport calls window.matchMedia without a typeof-window guard (harmless — client-only PWA, no SSR).
NIT: Map Layers keeps its own persisted ref instead of routing through useCollapsible (functionally equivalent; unify later).
NOTE: mql.addEventListener('change') needs iOS/Safari 14+ (initial paint correct regardless) — acceptable for the modern PWA target.
